theorem lg_target {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [Semiring α] [LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] [ExistsAddOfLE α] {f g : ι → α} [Fintype ι] (hfg : Antivary f g) : ↑(Fintype.card ι) * ∑ i, f i * g i ≤ (∑ i, f i) * ∑ i, g i := by
  let n := Fintype.card ι
  let sum_f := ∑ i, f i
  let sum_g := ∑ i, g i
  let sum_fg := ∑ i, f i * g i
  let sum_f_sq := ∑ i, f i * f i
  let sum_g_sq := ∑ i, g i * g i
  have h1 : (sum_f - sum_g) * (sum_f - sum_g) ≥ 0 := by apply nonneg_square
  have h2 : (sum_f - sum_g) * (sum_f - sum_g) = sum_f_sq - 2 * sum_fg + sum_g_sq := by rfl
  have h3 : sum_f_sq + sum_g_sq - 2 * sum_fg = (sum_f - sum_g) * (sum_f - sum_g) := by rfl
  have h4 : sum_f * sum_g - 2 * sum_fg = (sum_f - sum_g) * (sum_f - sum_g) - (sum_f_sq + sum_g_sq - 2 * sum_fg) := by rfl
  have h5 : sum_f * sum_g - 2 * sum_fg = 0 := by rw [h3, h4]
  have h6 : sum_f * sum_g = 2 * sum_fg := by rw [h5]
  have h7 : n * sum_fg ≤ sum_f * sum_g := by rw [h6]; apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right; exact Nat.cast_nonneg n
  exact h7
